items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: They recommended me and I went and auditioned for Herb Alpert.

ctx.x: They recommended me and I went and auditioned for Herb Alpert. He said, “Well you can have the gig, you can certainly do the gig but I want you to move back to L.A.” I said, “No, man, I’m not going to do that.”

Well from Herb Alpert to — Yeah, all these people. It’s amazing. One last thing and I don’t know if I can formulate this question so that you could try to answer it. Does jazz have a role in society now? I feel like it used to and I’m wondering if it still does in your opinion?
